notes.claim: Substitution turns two equations in two variables into one equation in one variable.
The substitution step puts the expression for one variable into the other equation.
For i2: a pair of equations with no solution is called inconsistent (HELM).
For i2: a system with an infinite number of solutions is named redundancy (SQA Advanced Higher).
